criteria.requirement: Extend Csv with a keyword-only mode='legacy_shell' default and opt-in mode='csv'. The CSV mode parses one strict CSV record, preserving backslashes, # characters, empty/trailing fields, quoted delimiters and doubled double quotes; reject malformed quoting, multiple records and non-single-character CSV delimiters with ValueError. Retain existing cast/strip/post_process semantics, None and legacy shell behavior; do not change Config precedence or repository reading.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
